Time as an Index — 31 Lean 4.36.0 theorems [T] · 0/32,768 SHA-256 spectral bins below p = 10^-6 (N = 65,536, unmetered)

Across 31 six-kernel Lean 4.36.0 theorems over discrete oracle models and N=65,536 SHA-256 spectral tests (0 / 32,768 FFT bins below Bonferroni p=10^-6), O(1) 'future lookup' reduces to salted-away Hellman precomputation.
